polyfills.name: Events
polyfills.line: Watch an MCP server for events such as failed deployments or new releases.
polyfills.alt: Claude Code watches a Cloudflare Worker. When the Worker throws a JSON parsing error, the idle session wakes and reports the error.

polyfills.name: Skills
polyfills.line: List skills an MCP server publishes and load their instructions and files on demand.
polyfills.alt: Codex lists skills from Hugging Face. The user approves loading huggingface-local-models, and Codex recommends Q4_K_M for a 7B model on a 16 GB Mac.
polyfills.note: Claude Code includes native Skills in beta from 2.1.332. Copilot CLI advertises native Skills support.

polyfills.name: Server Cards
polyfills.line: Find the MCP servers a domain publishes and add a selected server to your host.
polyfills.alt: Claude Code and Codex each list the servers published by neon.com. The user selects Neon Docs and approves adding it to the host configuration.

polyfills.name: Apps
polyfills.line: Use an MCP tool’s interface inline in the Claude Code terminal with the mouse and keyboard.
polyfills.alt: Claude Code displays DOOM, a CPU chart and a draggable 3D model inline. A terminal without image support displays the chart with text characters.

beyond.name: ARD discovery
beyond.spec: Agentic Resource Discovery v0.91, a draft outside MCP
beyond.line: Discover servers through a domain’s `ard.json` or search an ARD registry.
beyond.alt: Claude Code lists the MCP server published by buildkite.com. The user approves searching a local registry, which returns servers from Buildkite and Netlify.
beyond.note: Registry searches send your query to the registry you choose and require approval.
